questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Neither the board members nor the managing director _______ signed the revised memorandum.
questions.explanation: In proximity concord, when a plural subject ('board members') comes first and a singular subject ('the managing director') is closer to the verb, the singular verb 'has' is required.
questions.explanation_short: Singular verb 'has' agrees with 'the managing director'.
questions.explanation_pidgin: Even though 'board members' plenty, 'managing director' na one person and na im near the verb pass, so na 'has'.

questions.subject: English Language
questions.question: Choose the option nearest in meaning to the word in italics: The committee condemned the *brazen* disregard for constitutional procedure.
questions.explanation: 'Brazen' means bold and without shame, closely matching 'shameless'.
questions.explanation_pidgin: 'Brazen' mean person wey do bad thing with strong face without shame — 'shameless' correct.
